self_summary: Proven ground-truth rules ("breadcrumbs") captured after root-cause analyses of Flowpad bugs: agent personas and activity readouts, PTY queue and turn liveness, terminal rendering and theme, hub sign-in, bootstrap project resolution, encoding, sorting and release migrations, each with invariants and failure modes.

files.name: agent_activity_readout.md
files.title: Agent activity readout rules
files.summary: Proven rules for the chat activity line that reads the agent's current action from its own process event stream, with invariants and failure modes.

files.name: agent_session_persona.md
files.title: An agent session keeps the agent as its identity
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule that an agent session keeps the agent as its identity: agent launch embeds vibe as a layer, not a persona, after an RCA.

files.name: bootstrap_default_project.md
files.title: Bootstrap's default_project — which project a machine opens
files.summary: Breadcrumb on bootstrap default_project source order (browser memory, hub one-shot, last active project, @local), per-caller resolution, invariants, failure modes and client fix.

files.name: composer_readiness.md
files.title: Composer readiness is a generation property, not a recent-bytes property
files.summary: Breadcrumb on PTY composer readiness: the gate scanned only recent output, missing the vendor ready-marker after chatty turns, so readiness must be generation-scoped.

files.name: declared_persona.md
files.title: A process declares its persona; the renderer never infers one
files.summary: Breadcrumb ruling that a process declares its persona via set_ap_persona rather than the renderer inferring it from embedded agents, with invariants and failure modes.

files.name: dev_port_picking.md
files.title: Dev port picking for agent-started servers
files.summary: Breadcrumb rules for agent-started dev servers asking for a port via flow app free-dev-port, covering collisions with sibling builds and the picker taking no lease.

files.name: harness_login_state.md
files.title: What evidence may write a harness login state
files.summary: Breadcrumb rules for what evidence may write a harness login state, covering undetermined probes wrongly recorded as signed out and presence-only probes wrongly overturning refusals.

files.name: hub_signin_reconnect.md
files.title: Hub sign-in survives a hub socket reconnect
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule that hub sign-in must survive a hub websocket reconnect and be re-asked after a post-boot login, so hub-funded LLM endpoints stay available.

files.name: live_frame_identity.md
files.title: Live frames must name their transcript entry
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule that live wire frames must carry a transcript-entry id so observing clients keep their resume position, with invariants and failure modes

files.name: live_plan_detection.md
files.title: Live plan detection — the plan path lives on the attachment
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule that live plan detection must resolve the plan path from the plan_mode attachment, not ExitPlanMode, so plans surface on the same turn.

files.name: migration_slot.md
files.title: Migration open-slot must be advanced by the release
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule that a release must advance the open migration recipe slot to the next unreleased version, with invariants and failure modes

files.name: null_sort_order.md
files.title: NULL sort order in the SQLite driver
files.summary: Breadcrumb on NULL sort order in the SQLite driver: missing values sort first via a bucketed sort key and are never coerced to empty strings.

files.name: pty_queue_drain.md
files.title: Prompt queue didn't drain in PTY mode
files.summary: Breadcrumb on the PTY prompt queue never draining: a dead turn-end edge because prev_busy came from a per-instance attribute; behavior, internals, fix and invariants.

files.name: pty_turn_liveness.md
files.title: PTY turn cut off mid-generation
files.summary: Breadcrumb on PTY turns cut off mid-generation when the inactivity fallback misread transcript silence as idle; the proven fix, invariants and failure modes.

files.name: sandbox_browser_url.md
files.title: Sandbox preview urls: browser vs server
files.summary: Breadcrumb on sandbox preview URLs: a dev-server port needs a loopback URL for the server and a public per-port host for the browser.

files.name: served_html_encoding.md
files.title: Served app HTML must be read as UTF-8
files.summary: Breadcrumb rule that served app HTML must be read as UTF-8, never the host locale, to avoid Windows cp1252 mojibake and 500 errors

files.name: surface_transcript_reconcile.md
files.title: Surface change must reconcile the transcript
files.summary: Breadcrumb on surface changes: leaving the terminal must reset the worker to cli transport and force a transcript history reload; invariants and failure modes.

files.name: terminal_bidi.md
files.title: Terminal RTL/bidi rendering contract
files.summary: Breadcrumb on terminal RTL/bidi rendering: one bidi paragraph per row, buffer order chosen per CLI, container-mount and vendor-resolution triggers, invariants, failure modes, bound tests.

files.name: worker_interpreter.md
files.title: Worker interpreter resolution
files.summary: Breadcrumb on handing a worker its Python interpreter as FLOWPAD_PYTHON, since uv run and bare python do not find flow_sdk; invariants and failure modes.

files.name: worker_terminal_theme.md
files.title: Worker terminal theme is pinned at launch
files.summary: Breadcrumb on worker terminal theme: the CLI reads its theme at spawn, so it must ride the createProcess launch call, not the later open.

files.name: xml_entity_decode.md
files.title: XML entity decode belongs to the XML transport, not to FlowData
files.summary: Breadcrumb: XML entity decoding belongs to the XML transport only, covering just ampersand, less-than and greater-than, since a wider decode corrupts transcript history replay.
